name: Rox (rox-one) — headless dev
install:
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.14"; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bunx; fi
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bun install --frozen-lockfile
